description: PaSST-S OpenMIC checkpoint (openmic-passt-s-f128-10sec-p16-s10-ap.85.pt), frozen backbone exported with its 32 kHz mel frontend by artifacts/astra90/experiments/export_passt_features.py. Input float32[1,320000]; outputs features float32[1,768] and scores float32[1,20]. Only the short-clip bass-hit head reads it.
